text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Overdraft Policy v3.0 (effective 2026-01-01), Harbor charges $29 per item for items paid through Courtesy Pay, with a maximum of three (3) items per business day \n— so up to $87 a day. No overdraft fee is charged if your account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at the end of the business day, and no fee applies to items Harbor returns unpaid. If you use Overdraft Transfer Protection from a linked Primary Share Account, that transfer fee is $5.00 and only one such fee is charged per business day no matter how many items the transfer covers.","cited_chunk_ids":["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The Overdraft Policy v3 fee section states the per-item fee and the three-item daily cap."}
